scope: CAD self-interference on modelled bodies, nominal geometry only
fold_rule: q3+q4 >= -90 deg; screening only, actual CAD calculation still required
limitations: Only supplied geometry: additional attachment fasteners, cables, fixtures and environment are not checked
Tangent contact is not volumetric interference; no clearance/tolerance warranty
Finite pose checks do not prove continuous paths
No strength, torque or physical fit acceptance
Each supplied motor reference is a rigid case-level collision group; internal gears/horn motion is not independently simulated
